scope: Bounded strategy catalog for state-aware timing classification. It does not change factual action requirements or select a route.

windows.stop_condition: Stop after quest completion and the fixed coin reward; keep choice XP unallocated until explicitly assigned.
windows.reentry_condition: Re-enter only to reclaim or allocate the separate choice-XP reward.

windows.stop_condition: Stop after the quest, fixed Prayer XP, and Ghostspeak amulet are confirmed.
windows.reentry_condition: Re-enter ghost content only for a separately named quest or utility dependency.

windows.stop_condition: Stop after 1,000 Hunter XP, 1,000 Slayer XP, and 28 Kudos are confirmed.
windows.reentry_condition: Re-enter the Museum only for a separately named Kudos or quest objective.

windows.stop_condition: Stop after Chronicle ownership is confirmed; cards remain a separate consumable decision.
windows.reentry_condition: Re-enter for a named card purchase, replacement, or repeated teleport need.

windows.stop_condition: Stop after Varlamore access is confirmed.
windows.reentry_condition: Re-enter for a separately named Varlamore quest, activity, or internal transport unlock.

windows.stop_condition: Stop after spirit-tree access and the fixed quest reward are confirmed.
windows.reentry_condition: Re-enter the region only for another named quest, transport, or activity objective.

windows.stop_condition: Stop after gnome-glider access and the fixed quest rewards are confirmed.
windows.reentry_condition: Re-enter the region for a separately named dependency or activity.

windows.stop_condition: Stop after player-owned-house ownership is confirmed.
windows.reentry_condition: Re-enter for a named room, relocation, furniture, or teleport objective.

windows.stop_condition: Stop after Sailing access and Pandemonium's fixed rewards are confirmed.
windows.reentry_condition: Re-enter at a named Sailing activity, destination, or funded Skiff checkpoint.

windows.stop_condition: Stop after the current observed cycle is collected and reset, or its named supply target is met.
windows.reentry_condition: Re-enter when access, inputs, and a ready cycle are explicitly observed.

windows.stop_condition: Stop after the current observed harvest/reset or declared seaweed target.
windows.reentry_condition: Re-enter when access, spores, tools, and a ready patch are explicitly observed.

windows.stop_condition: Stop after one Seed box purchase is confirmed.
windows.reentry_condition: Normally do not re-enter for this completed one-time utility.

windows.stop_condition: Stop after one Herb sack purchase is confirmed.
windows.reentry_condition: Consider the Silklined upgrade only after its separate drop is observed.

windows.stop_condition: Stop after one Coal bag purchase is confirmed.
windows.reentry_condition: Re-enter Motherlode Mine only for another named objective.

windows.stop_condition: Stop after one Gem bag purchase is confirmed.
windows.reentry_condition: Re-enter Motherlode Mine only for another named objective.

windows.stop_condition: Stop after one Rune pouch purchase is confirmed.
windows.reentry_condition: Do not re-enter MTA for this objective after the pouch is owned.

windows.stop_condition: Stop at the named Fishing or permit target; stop on an observed Fish Barrel when it is the only target.
windows.reentry_condition: Re-enter for a new Fishing, food, permit, or enjoyment objective.

windows.stop_condition: Stop on the named reward, input allocation boundary, or reserve-policy change.
windows.reentry_condition: Re-enter for a new named reward with fresh input and reserve observations.

windows.stop_condition: Stop at the named learning, rune, equipment, diary, or session boundary.
windows.reentry_condition: Re-enter for a new named purpose with a current travel, supply, and recovery plan.

windows.stop_condition: Stop at the named practice, equipment, resource, collection, or session boundary.
windows.reentry_condition: Re-enter when a new objective and current combat/recovery observations exist.

windows.stop_condition: Stop at the declared learning, attention, risk, resource, equipment, or collection boundary.
windows.reentry_condition: Re-enter with formal access, a fresh high-attention objective, and current readiness observations.
